title: InsuranceClaim
description: An inbound insurance claim event delivered to the claims triage agent.

claimant_id.description: Identifier of the claimant in the CRM.

claimed_amount.description: Dollar amount claimed by the insured.

description.description: Claimant's written description of the incident.

recorded_call_url.description: Presigned URL to the recorded intake call audio file, if available.

attachments.description: Presigned URLs to supporting documents or photos.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the claim was filed.
